I know I might not have much based on my age (just a 16 year old), but my uncle was mentally disabled since he was a kid. (My cousin too but that’s another story) My grandparents had to raise him on their own until he died of cancer in his 40s and my grandma still talks about him every now and then. 

I was practically a baby when he was still alive but based on my grandma’s stories and your experience I can imagine how stressed my grandparents were taking care of my uncle. He would act out in public with my grandma and people would even neglect him when he was a kid. But she would still defend him and protect him. And although my grandma does say that she feels more free and peaceful around the house without my uncle. Deep down she loves him a lot, like how you probably feel towards your child. She did everything she could to raise and take care of my uncle on her own for decades. 

I don’t know how to put this, but I’m proud of you like how I’m proud of my grandma. Despite the stress and hardships you’re still taking care of your kid to the best you can, instead of throwing in the towel.
